Include Alaska and Hawaii on the national maps. 2. The county-level data excludes a lot of towns, Louisiana's parishes, and many metropolitan areas that don't follow the "NAME COUNTY" pattern. (We should examine the share of arrests in each state that make each of the patterns.) 3. We could create an interactive line graph with all of the state arrest rates. ::: {.cell} ::: Maps and tables below cover arrests on or after **January 20, 2025**. **384,475** arrests · **95.2%** have a state recorded. The monthly trend chart shows the full dataset for context. --- ## State Bubble Map Circle **area** is proportional to the number of arrests. Circle **color** shows arrests per 1,000 estimated undocumented immigrants (Pew 2023 estimates), a rough intensity measure independent of state size. Popups include Census 2025 total population and per-capita rates. ::: {.cell} ::: ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](nationwide-arrests_files/figure-html/ratio-trend-1.png){width=1056} ::: ::: --- ## Removal Destinations ::: {.cell} ::: `departure_country` records where each person was actually sent. Of **308,163** removals with a recorded destination, **12,553** (4.1%) involved removal to a country other than the person's citizenship country. The grid below shows nationalities and destinations with at least 500 removals. ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](nationwide-arrests_files/figure-html/nationwide-removal-grid-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: --- ## Data notes - Source: [Deportation Data Project](https://deportationdata.org), FOIA 2026-ICLI-00005. - Maps and tables filtered to arrests on or after **January 20, 2025** (384,475 arrests). Trend chart shows the full dataset from October 2022 – September 2026. - `apprehension_state` is missing for 18,354 post-cutoff rows (4.8%); excluded from state and county counts. - County extraction uses the regex `^([A-Z .'-]+) COUNTY` on the `apprehension_site_landmark` field. Multi-word county names (e.g., "Crow Wing") are captured; names embedded mid-string are not. - Alaska and Hawaii are not shown in the continental US maps. - **Census population** from U.S. Census Bureau, "Annual Estimates of the Resident Population for the United States, Regions, States, District of Columbia and Puerto Rico" (NST-EST2025-POP.xlsx), July 1 2025 estimates. - **Undocumented population** from Pew Research Center, "Unauthorized immigrants: Characteristics for states" (2023 estimates, released 2025). Estimates are rounded to the nearest 5,000–50,000 depending on state size. - Arrest intensity (arrests per 1,000 undocumented) uses Pew 2023 undocumented population as denominator; this is the most recent state-level estimate available.
